newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Five children die as house burns in Honduras.
newsitem.headline: Five children die as house burns in Honduras.

text.p: Five children left home alone while their mothers attended a religious ceremony were killed in a fire in central Honduras, officials said on Sunday.
The fire began late on Saturday when a candle fell onto one of the childrens' beds in the town of Valle de Angeles, 14 miles (20 km) east of the capital Tegucigalpa.
"We are mourning a great tragedy. This is the first time we have ever seen anything like this here, the whole town is very moved," Mayor Luis Salgado told reporters.
One child, 10, escaped the fire and was treated for smoke inhalation. The children who died were all boys. Three were age 4 and two were age 6, officials said.
They belonged to two different families, but were left under the same roof while their mothers were out.
